bug_info.bug_desc: The instruction fetch PMP/PMA check unconditionally overwrites the fetch exception when a PMP or PMA violation is detected, without checking whether the fetch request is valid or whether the incoming request already carries a higher-priority exception such as an instruction page fault. This can incorrectly replace an instruction page fault with an instruction access fault, violating RISC-V exception-priority rules and causing incorrect trap reporting.
bug_info.fix_hint: Apply the PMP/PMA instruction access-fault override only for valid fetch requests and only when the incoming fetch exception is not already an instruction page fault. Preserve higher-priority page-fault exceptions instead of replacing them with instruction access faults.
